summary: Learn to inventory unsanctioned AI use, classify risk, and design practical controls. Explore the five-day Shadow AI training course.
lede: Shadow AI governance training helps security, compliance, privacy, risk, and audit professionals identify and manage unapproved AI use. It covers discovering AI services, mapping data exposure, classifying use cases, setting tiered acceptable-use rules, and defining controls and audit evidence. Participants use the NIST AI RMF and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications as references while developing practical inventories, risk registers, policy outlines, and reporting plans.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals responsible for finding, assessing, controlling, or assuring employee use of unsanctioned generative AI tools across enterprise systems.
modules: OWASP LLM Threat and Data Controls
prerequisites: Working knowledge of enterprise information security, data protection, IT risk, or internal audit controls is expected. No coding or programming is required. Learners should be able to review basic application-access or security-log information; hands-on exercises use spreadsheet-based registers and case scenarios.
